name: Cedar Hill Village
summary: Cedar Hill Village is a community shopping center on North Highway 67 in Cedar Hill, Texas, managed by CenterPoint Commercial Companies. The center serves local residents with convenient retail and services, maintaining a strong 4.4-star rating from the community.
demographics: Cedar Hill Village serves a diverse suburban community in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, primarily attracting middle-income families and working professionals from Cedar Hill and surrounding areas. The trade area consists of established residential neighborhoods with a mix of homeowners and renters, including young families with children and middle-aged households. Shoppers typically visit for convenient access to everyday necessities and services, with a preference for value-oriented retailers and practical shopping experiences that serve daily needs.
description: Cedar Hill Village is a neighborhood shopping center located at 475 North Highway 67 in Cedar Hill, Texas, serving the southern Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. Managed by CenterPoint Commercial Companies, a Dallas-based commercial real estate firm specializing in property management, development, brokerage, and capital services, the center provides convenient access to retail and services for the local community. The property benefits from its prominent location along Highway 67, offering easy accessibility for residents of Cedar Hill and surrounding areas. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily, Cedar Hill Village caters to shoppers seeking convenient access to everyday goods and services. The center has earned a strong reputation among local residents, reflected in its 4.4-star rating from over 800 Google reviews, demonstrating its role as a valued community shopping destination in the Cedar Hill area.
